newsitem.title: UK: Mill demand highly selective in Europe raw cotton.
newsitem.headline: Mill demand highly selective in Europe raw cotton.

text.p: Trading enterprise was again at a low ebb on most European raw cotton markets.

The firmness of nearby asking rates for most origins, reflecting relatively tight supply through to the movement of the season's new crops, was reinforced by Friday's strong performance on the New York futures market.
But mill buyers were reluctant to absorb any further rise in raw cotton replacement costs, so demand stayed highly selective and new business was modest in current and new crop cotton.
